In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the effect of carotenoid supplements on retinal sensitivity and macular pigmentation in different phenotypes and early stages of AMD.
the development of a new method for the measurement of the macular pigments in the human retina.

carotenoid supplementation may be useful for the RPD phenotype of early AMD.
the RPD phenotype of AMD is not a benign condition, but rather an early manifestation of AMD with a different pathophysiology, and thus a potential target for therapeutic interventions.
the results of the current study suggest that carotenoid supplementation can improve macular pigment density in patients with early AMD.

the RPD phenotype of AMD responds well to supplementation with carotenoids.

RPD is a different phenotype from medium/large druse.
